title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Empty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, Len... Have you seen KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me neither. Um, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No... I just realized that I haven't seen him at all lately...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But, we haven't seen MEIKO either, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh... I saw MEIKO before I met you Rin.
I showed her my cat's cradle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really...? I wonder if she's still there.
I want to ask her about KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Are you gonna go look for her?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My, what brings you three together at once?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't know you were here too, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why, yes. We were just having an interesting conversation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, we weren't.
Luka was just talking at me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, you're a good listener, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to ask you two something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Have either of you seen KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I haven't for a while.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Maybe he's avoiding us?
Since he finds us annoying to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That might be true about you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, how about I shout in a loud voice, “Look, Mafuyu's here!”?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, perhaps KAITO will hear me and show up?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright then... Do you know any other ways to call or search for him?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
See? So let's try it, shall we?
Here I go...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh look, he came before I even called him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was walking around this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh, now? After all this time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Specifically now, after all this time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mafuyu has now told her mother her true feelings. I suspected that that might cause some changes to occur.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As of yet, I haven't seen any evidence of that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it was for Mafuyu's sake...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO, are you going to keep watching over Mafuyu and the others with us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If it is called for, yes.
